cases.content:
4 months ago, my friend was stuck in a 9-5.

Passionate about finance. Zero time to make content.

I gave him 9 Claude prompts and said: "Just run these."

Week 1: First video uploaded. No face. No mic. Phone notes.
Week 4: 1,200 subscribers.
Month 3: First $800 AdSense deposit.
Month 4: $2,670. Resignation letter sent.

Here are the exact 9 prompts. Copy. Paste. Publish.
cases.author: Suryanshti777
cases.summary: 友人がClaudeプロンプトを使い、顔出し・声出しなしのYouTubeで月2,670ドルを稼ぎ、4ヶ月で会社を辞めた事例。
cases.method: Claudeプロンプトを利用した顔出しなしYouTubeチャンネル運営
